prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE NEW professional contemporary graphic logo for Chinese company 达州礼林生态科技有限责任公司, brand 礼林生态 / LILIN ECO. The company spans software and systems, engineering and practical/ecological services. Core values 善心、善念、善行 mean care, thoughtful joining and purposeful action. Prefer a strong unique silhouette and a few broad shapes over dense hidden lettering. Derive subtle structure from 礼 turn/open hook and 林 paired support without forcing complete characters. Independent design: NO existing image reference. Construction: ONE BROAD DIAGONAL LANCE-SHAPED LEAF-LIKE SILHOUETTE, but sculpted from TWO sharply clipped flat planes with TWO big rectangular white windows cut THROUGH its middle, NOT veins. The windows share a short upright to evoke paired 木, lower edge curls into one open 礼-hook. Leaf is geometric and robust, not delicate botanical illustration or spa clipart. Strong asymmetry, large cuts, only 2-3 pieces. Palette: Burnt orange, deep ultramarine and one restrained raspberry meeting face, NO green. PURE WHITE background, one centered standalone emblem with ample margins. DO NOT render any words or captions; a neutral company wordmark will be added separately for comparison. Medium visual weight with generous white cuts, crisp vector-like flat artwork. No mockup, decorative illustration, texture, 3D, shadows, global rainbow wash, generic stock icon, business-icon collage or copied established logo.
